ranking.method: Packaged stdio servers ranked by package downloads over the last month (npm downloads API, pypistats); one entry per package. Ranks 1-500 are the most-downloaded packages; later ranks continue with every further npm or PyPI package with at least 1,000 downloads in the last month whose pinned version resolves on its registry. Container-only servers have no download signal and rank last, in registry (alphabetical) order, when their pinned image tag or digest resolves. Hosted (remote) servers have no install count and are listed separately with rank null: only servers whose domain-verified registry namespace (for example com.stripe) matches the URL host, ordered by the Tranco popularity of that domain, one per domain.

servers.name: io.github.antonorlov/mcp-postgres-server
servers.title: PostgreSQL
servers.description: MCP server for PostgreSQL: local, Docker, RDS, Neon, Supabase, or behind an SSH bastion.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

env.name: PG_HOST
env.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

env.name: PG_PORT
env.description: Database port.

env.name: PG_USER
env.description: Database user.

env.name: PG_PASSWORD
env.description: Database password.

env.name: PG_DATABASE
env.description: Database name.

env.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

env.name: PG_SSLMODE
env.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a se

env.name: PG_SSL_CA
env.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

env.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
env.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

env.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
env.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

env.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

env.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

env.name: PG_SSH_HOST
env.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

env.name: PG_SSH_PORT
env.description: SSH bastion port.

env.name: PG_SSH_USER
env.description: SSH username.

env.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

env.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

env.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
env.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

env.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
env.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

env.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
env.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

env.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
env.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

servers.title: Iris
servers.description: Stop shipping agents on vibes. Score every agent output for quality, safety, and cost.

env.name: IRIS_API_KEY
env.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

env.name: IRIS_API_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to a file whose trimmed contents are the API key (the secret-file pattern Docker and Kubernetes mount). Set this or IRIS_API_KEY, not both; further keys and rotation are security.apiKeys in confi

env.name: IRIS_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
env.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)

env.name: IRIS_DB_PATH
env.description: SQLite database path

env.name: IRIS_SQLITE_DRIVER
env.description: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22.13+). Unset: native, falling back to node when the native module cannot load

env.name: IRIS_SEARCH_BUDGET_MS
env.description: How long one trace search may read before it answers with the matches found so far, in milliseconds (50-60000, default 1000)

env.name: IRIS_SEARCH_INDEX
env.description: on (default) or off. off keeps no full-text index of the traces: writes are cheaper, and a search reads the traces within its time budget

env.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

env.name: IRIS_HOME
env.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)

env.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

env.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

env.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL
env.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one judge or citation call (default 0.25)

env.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MODEL
env.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)

env.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
env.description: What the relevance judge may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1); past it answers_the_ask reads the ask lexically

env.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST
env.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)

env.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_REDACT
env.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are

env.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH
env.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default)

env.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD
env.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)

env.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT
env.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)

env.name: IRIS_PORT
env.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http

env.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT
env.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)

env.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS
env.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on)

env.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport

env.name: IRIS_HOST
env.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http

env.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)

env.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST
env.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host

env.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS
env.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)

env.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
env.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)

env.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request

env.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json

env.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one

servers.name: io.github.mcpsmiths/tracehub-mcp
servers.title: tracehub
servers.description: Query OTel traces across Jaeger, Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, X-Ray, New Relic, Honeycomb.

env.name: BACKEND_TYPE
env.description: Which observability backend to query.

env.name: BACKEND_URL
env.description: Backend API endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:16686 for Jaeger, https://api.datadoghq.com for Datadog, https://api.newrelic.com/graphql for New Relic, or https://api.honeycomb.io for Honeycomb. For the

env.name: BACKEND_API_KEY
env.description: API key or auth token. Required for Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, and Honeycomb; not used by Jaeger, Tempo, or X-Ray. For New Relic this must be a User API key, not an Ingest or License key;

env.name: BACKEND_AWS_REGION
env.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required for the X-Ray backend only - X-Ray authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain, not BACKEND_API_KEY.

env.name: BACKEND_NEWRELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: New Relic account ID, required for the New Relic backend only - NerdGraph queries are user-scoped, not account-scoped, so this identifies which account's data to read.

env.name: BACKEND_HONEYCOMB_DATASET
env.description: Honeycomb dataset slug, required for the Honeycomb backend only - the Query Data API is dataset-scoped.

env.name: BACKEND_APP_KEY
env.description: Datadog Application key, required in addition to BACKEND_API_KEY for the Datadog backend only.

env.name: BACKEND_TEMPO_INSTANCE_ID
env.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used with BACKEND_API_KEY for Basic Auth (Tempo backend only, required for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo, not needed for self-hosted Tempo).

env.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_ORG
env.description: Sentry organization slug, required for the Sentry backend only.

env.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_PROJECT
env.description: Sentry project slug, optional for the Sentry backend - narrows queries to one project.

env.name: BACKEND_ENVIRONMENTS
env.description: Comma-separated environments for the Traceloop backend only.

env.name: BACKEND_TIMEOUT
env.description: Request timeout in seconds.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level.

env.name: MAX_TRACES_PER_QUERY
env.description: Maximum traces validated per query (1-1000).

env.name: SLOW_REQUEST_THRESHOLD_MS
env.description: Logs a WARNING for any backend request slower than this, independent of LOG_LEVEL. Unset disables slow-request logging.

env.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
env.description: Enables opt-in OTel self-instrumentation of tool calls when set. Unset means zero overhead - no TracerProvider is configured and no middleware is registered.

env.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
env.description: Service name reported in self-instrumentation spans, only used when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

env.name: MCP_INCLUDE_ARGS_IN_SPANS
env.description: Include tool call arguments/results as OTel span attributes when self-instrumentation is enabled. Off by default since they may contain sensitive data.

claude: claude mcp add tracehub -e BACKEND_TYPE=<BACKEND_TYPE> -e BACKEND_URL=<BACKEND_URL> -- uvx tracehub-mcp@0.12.3
codex: codex mcp add tracehub --env BACKEND_TYPE=<BACKEND_TYPE> --env BACKEND_URL=<BACKEND_URL> -- uvx tracehub-mcp@0.12.3

env.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_FALLBACK_LIVE
env.description: Fall back to the live API when the mirror is cold, missing the record, or failing. Disable to fail loudly instead.

env.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Wall-clock budget for one scheduled refresh before it is aborted. Raise it for drug/label, the only multi-partition dataset.

env.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_BASE_URL
env.description: Host serving the openFDA bulk download manifest. Override only to harvest from a private mirror of the dumps.

servers.name: io.github.williansaez/abap-adt-mcp
servers.title: abap-adt
servers.description: ABAP development from Claude and other MCP hosts: source, transports, tests, ATC, debugger

env.name: SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE
env.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/sso2/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

env.name: SAP_SYSTEMS
env.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

env.name: SAP_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
env.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

env.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
env.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), sso2, basic, or oauth

env.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
env.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

env.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
env.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

env.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

env.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_SESSIONS
env.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

env.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
env.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

env.name: MCP_HTTP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES
env.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

env.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

env.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

env.name: MCP_EXPORT_ROOT
env.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

env.name: MCP_AUDIT_FILE
env.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)

env.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to 1 to make every destination read-only (server-side; only read-only annotated tools plus login/logout run). Per-destination policies live in systems.json

env.name: MCP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW
env.description: Set to 1 to let tableContents read table and CDS rows on every destination that does not state policy.allowDataPreview itself (reading table data is off by default)

env.name: MCP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL
env.description: Set to 1 to allow runQuery and tableContents with sqlQuery on every destination that does not state policy.allowFreeSql itself (free SQL is off by default; implies table data)

env.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
env.description: Toolsets to publish: comma list (core,source,objects,transports,analysis,tests,atc,data,discovery,runtime,refactoring,rap,services,git,debugger,traces) or a preset: all (default) or focused

env.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLSETS
env.description: Toolsets to hide, comma list (core cannot be disabled)

env.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
env.description: Character budget for a single tool response before results are paged/truncated (default 40000, minimum 5000). Raise it if your MCP host accepts larger tool outputs

env.name: SAP_ALLOW_REENTRANCE_TICKET
env.description: Set to 1 to enable the reentranceTicket tool (disabled by default: it returns a live SAP logon credential into the conversation)

env.name: SAP_URL
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

env.name: SAP_USER
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP username

env.name: SAP_PASSWORD
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP password

env.name: SAP_CLIENT
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP client number, e.g. 100

env.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: logon language, e.g. EN

env.name: SAP_BROWSER_PATH
env.description: SSO destinations: path to a Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary for the browser login (auto-detected when unset)

env.name: SAP_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
env.description: SSO destinations: directory of the persistent browser profile that keeps the identity-provider session (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/sso/<host>)

env.name: SAP_SSO2_COMMAND
env.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: absolute path to the trusted local ticket provider

env.name: SAP_SSO2_ARGS
env.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: JSON array of provider arguments (never put a ticket here)

env.name: SAP_SSO2_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: provider timeout in milliseconds (default 30000; range 1000-300000)

env.name: SAP_TLS_INSECURE
env.description: Legacy single-system mode: set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification for that system only (sandboxes with self-signed certificates)

env.name: SAP_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
env.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 token endpoint (client_credentials)

env.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client id

env.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client secret

env.name: SAP_OAUTH_SCOPE
env.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: optional OAuth2 scope

env.name: MCP_PROFILE_GATE
env.description: Platform gate for toolsets the destination does not expose (debugger, traces, abapGit, ...): enforce (default, refuse before calling SAP), warn (log only) or off

env.name: MCP_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS

env.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

env.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

env.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

env.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

env.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

env.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

env.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

env.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
env.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_d

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
env.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effec

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_SERVER_NAME
env.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
env.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
env.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
env.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

env.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

env.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
env.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

env.name: SCHOLAR_GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub token used to raise rate limits when fetching standards documents from GitHub. Optional; unauthenticated requests work at reduced limits.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: When true, write-tagged tools (PDF download and conversion cache writes) are hidden. Set false to enable them.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_S2_API_KEY
env.description: Semantic Scholar API key. Optional but strongly recommended: unauthenticated requests are limited to ~1 req/s. Request one at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key-form.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_DOCLING_URL
env.description: Base URL of a running docling-serve instance for PDF conversion (e.g. http://localhost:5001). When unset, PDF conversion tools return an error.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_VLM_API_URL
env.description: OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoint for formula and figure enrichment during PDF conversion.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_VLM_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the VLM endpoint.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_VLM_MODEL
env.description: Model name to use with the VLM endpoint.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_CACHE_DIR
env.description: Directory for the SQLite cache database (cache.db) and downloaded PDFs (pdfs/, md/).

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_CONTACT_EMAIL
env.description: Contact email for the OpenAlex polite pool (improves rate limits). Also enables Unpaywall lookups as a PDF fallback source.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_EPO_CONSUMER_KEY
env.description: EPO Open Patent Services consumer key. Optional; patent tools are hidden when unset. Register at https://developers.epo.org/user/register.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_EPO_CONSUMER_SECRET
env.description: EPO Open Patent Services consumer secret. Optional; patent tools are hidden when unset.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY
env.description: Google Books API key. Optional; book tools work unauthenticated at reduced rate limits.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S
env.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S
env.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT
env.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.

env.name: USERS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS

env.name: MEDIA_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Highest timeout an upload may request, in milliseconds.

servers.title: KPN Grexx
servers.description: KPN IRMA on Grexx: address checks, prequalification, customers, orders, mobile and line tools.

env.name: KPN_GREXX_USERNAME
env.description: Grexx API username. Passed to the SDK as the OAuth client_id (portal: API Gegevens). The SDK sends it with HTTP Basic on the token endpoint. This server does not mint the token.

env.name: KPN_GREXX_PASSWORD
env.description: Grexx API password. Passed to the SDK as the OAuth client_secret (scope=all). The SDK sends it with HTTP Basic on the token endpoint.

env.name: KPN_GREXX_BASE_URL
env.description: Grexx interface root, without /realtime. Env only — never a gateway header. No default; acceptatie and production differ.

env.name: KPN_GREXX_TOKEN_URL
env.description: OAuth token endpoint. Env only — never a gateway header. Production will differ from acceptatie.

env.name: KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API
env.description: Set to 1 to also register the developer.kpn.com tools (disturbances, availability, SIM swap, MSM). Default is Grexx only.

env.name: KPN_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com project client ID. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1.

env.name: KPN_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com project client secret. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1, together with KPN_CLIENT_ID.

env.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional legacy MSM app ID. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1. Must be paired with KPN_MSM_CLIENT_SECRET.

env.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Optional legacy MSM app secret. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1, together with KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID.

env.name: KPN_BASE_URL
env.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com base URL. Env only. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

env.name: AUTH_MODE
env.description: Credential source: 'env' reads KPN_GREXX_* locally, 'gateway' expects X-KPN-Grexx-Username and X-KPN-Grexx-Password. Base URL and token URL stay env-only.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error

env.name: MCP_K8S_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport: stdio | http | sse. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Default wall-clock timeout per job, seconds.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Maximum wall-clock timeout a caller may request, seconds.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
env.description: Cap on combined stdout/stderr before truncation.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES
env.description: Cap on the total size of returned artifacts.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_CONCURRENT
env.description: Maximum ephemeral pods running at the same time.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_CPU
env.description: Pod CPU request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_MEMORY
env.description: Pod memory request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

env.name: MCP_K8S_SIDECAR_IMAGE
env.description: Helper image used to inject input files and collect artifacts.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_IMAGE
env.description: Image carrying git for the clone init container. Empty disables the clone field.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_SECRET
env.description: Secret with git tokens, mounted only on the cloner. Empty disables the clone field.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_PVC
env.description: Existing PVC mounted into every job pod as a shared cache. Empty = no cache.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_MOUNT_PATH

env.name: MCP_K8S_JOB_EXTRA_ENV
env.description: JSON object of env vars added to every job pod; caller keys win on collision.

env.description: Optional X-MCP-AUTH token required on every request (http/sse transports only).
